claims.statement: Interleaving reasoning traces (thoughts) with external environment interactions (acts) improves decision grounding and mitigates error propagation.
Unit test suites and reproduction tests provide unambiguous ground-truth validation for evaluating multi-file software engineering tasks.
Deterministic API execution enables language models to overcome probabilistic weaknesses in arithmetic, temporal reasoning, and factual retrieval.
Dynamic episodic verbal reflection driven by environment feedback improves task completion rates without gradient descent or model weight mutation.

Reconciling probabilistic model generation with deterministic verification requires strict structural separation: models propose changes, deterministic harnesses enforce invariants, and test suites validate acceptance.
claims.primary_source: Multiple (Yao et al., Jimenez et al., Schick et al., Shinn et al.)
